research_question: How is generative AI changing software engineering productivity, code quality, and employment?

observations.label: Logic and Correctness Issues
observations.evidence_text: Logic and correctness issues rise 75%, including business logic errors, misconfigurations, and unsafe control flow.

observations.label: Security Vulnerabilities in AI-Generated Code
observations.evidence_text: Security vulnerabilities rise 1.5–2x, especially improper password handling and insecure object references.

observations.label: Developers Trusting AI Output Without Testing
observations.evidence_text: A 2026 statistic worth highlighting: 58% of developers report trusting AI output without testing it.

observations.label: AI-Generated or Assisted Code in Organizations
observations.evidence_text: 61% of organizational code is now AI-generated or AI-assisted.

observations.label: Test Suite Maintenance Burden
observations.evidence_text: 70% of respondents said test suite maintenance is now a bigger burden than writing code itself.
